severity.description: Default severity level applied to all rules. Individual rules can override this value.
The severity level of the lint diagnostic. 'error' marks violations as errors, 'warning' as warnings, and 'info' as informational messages.

targetPattern.description: A glob pattern for matching source files relative to the package root. Must not use 'package:' URIs or the '$TARGET_DIR' variable.

disallowPattern.description: A glob pattern for matching disallowed imports. Supports relative paths (e.g., 'lib/**'), 'package:' URIs for external packages, 'dart:' URIs for core libraries, and the '$TARGET_DIR' variable which expands to the parent directory of the matched source file.

targetOrList.description: A single target pattern or a list of target patterns.

disallowOrList.description: A single disallow pattern or a list of disallow patterns.

rule.description: An import rule that defines which imports are disallowed for files matching the target pattern. Rules are evaluated in the order: target, exclude_target, disallow, exclude_disallow.

reason.description: A human-readable message explaining why this import is disallowed. This message is shown in the lint diagnostic.
examples: The domain layer should not depend on other layers.
Features should be isolated from each other except the core module.
Use custom components instead of directly importing built-in widgets.

target.description: Glob pattern(s) specifying which source files this rule applies to.

exclude_target.description: Glob pattern(s) specifying source files to exclude from this rule, even if they match 'target'.

disallow.description: Glob pattern(s) specifying which imports are disallowed for the matched source files.

exclude_disallow.description: Glob pattern(s) specifying imports to allow, even if they match 'disallow'. Supports the '$TARGET_DIR' variable.

severity.description: Severity level for this specific rule, overriding the top-level default.
